questions.question: Define wellness.Explain its main dimensions.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Definition -(1 mark), any four dimensions-2 narks
  • Wellness is the state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the
  • absence of disease.
  • Main dimensions include
  • • Physical wellness: Maintaining a healthy body through exercise, nutrition, and sleep.
  • • Mental/Emotional wellness: Ability to cope with stress and maintain positive
  • thinking.
  • • Social wellness: Maintaining healthy relationships and social interactions.
  • • Intellectual
  • • Spiritual
  • • Occupational
  • • Cultural
  • • Financial

questions.question: Discuss the effect of aerobic exercise on muscles.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Define aerobic exercise- 1; benefits on muscular system (any 4) -4
  • Aerobic exercise such as walking, running, cycling, and swimming improves muscle
  • endurance and strength. It increases oxygen supply to muscles, helping them work efficiently
  • for longer periods. Regular aerobic activity improves muscle tone, enhances blood
  • circulation, and reduces fatigue. It also increases mitochondrial activity in muscle cells
  • improving energy production and overall muscular performance.
questions.final_answer: improving energy production and overall muscular performance
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe how peer relationships influence adolescent mental health
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: any five points
  • Peer relationships play an important role in adolescent development. Positive peer support
  • can increase confidence, improve communication skills, and reduce stress. Healthy
  • friendships provide emotional support and a sense of belonging. However, negative peer
  • pressure can lead to risky behaviors, anxiety, and poor decision-making. Therefore
  • supportive and respectful peer relationships contribute significantly to good mental health in
  • adolescents. Liberal valuation

questions.question: Explain stretching exercises and their importance.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Any five points
  • Stretching exercises involve gently extending muscles to improve flexibility and range of
  • motion. These exercises help prepare the body for physical activity and reduce the risk of
  • injury. Stretching improves muscle coordination, increases blood circulation, and reduces
  • muscle stiffness. Regular stretching also improves posture, relaxation, and overall physical
  • performance.
